entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this helmet I bought. It's been a complete waste of my time and I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine, hold on. It's VF88602. Now hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. I see the order for the Urban Commuter Helmet here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference! The color is absolutely not what it looked like online. It's hideous. I haven't even bothered with it, the box is still unopened right here on my desk. I just want to send it back.

I understand the color wasn't what you expected. I can assure you that while the shade may differ slightly, the helmet provides the highest level of safety, which is our top priority for all our riders.

I don't care about your little safety speech! Are you going to process this return or not? Your website says 90 days. I'm looking at it right now. If you can't do your job, get me your manager. I am more than happy to write reviews everywhere about this.
There's no need for that, sir. Let me just pull up the policy for your item... One moment.
Okay, yes, I've confirmed it. My apologies for the delay. You are correct, your purchase is well within the 90-day return window. I can process this return for you immediately.
Finally. About time. So what now?

I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be issued.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through. This was way more difficult than it needed to be.
The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
